rule: A role below cannot be substituted by a code path, a test fixture or generated text. Claude Code prepares; it never attests, determines, authorizes or verifies on behalf of a person.

may_prepare: protocols, schemas, templates and blank forms
validators, the run ledger and the repository scan
questions for counsel and decision requests for the owner
reports of what is present and what is absent
may_not: attest independence, rights, completion or custody
interpret or label an evaluation record
determine a legal or compliance question
authorize intake, a freeze, a provider call, a release or a publication

must: declare independence and any conflict, in their own attestation
extract and interpret each record under the frozen Codebook revision, blind to candidate output
record uncertainty and insufficient basis where they apply
resolve recorded disagreements under the frozen adjudication protocol
be distinct from the reviewers whose interpretations are adjudicated
attest completion status and chain of custody for each record
hold record text outside this repository

must_review: lawful basis and confidentiality for evaluation records
data flows, storage, retention and deletion for the evaluation
rights in reviewer work and results
any statement about an evaluation result

must_authorize: freezing the Codebook revision and the interpretation, calibration and adjudication protocols
any provider call on evaluation records
any release-gate change, on recorded evidence

must_verify: an authorized production deployment, after the owner release authorization

prohibited_until.until: owner opening record, counsel review and rights attestation (ATT-01 to ATT-03)

prohibited_until.action: run the Engine or any provider on an evaluation record
prohibited_until.until: owner authorization for provider calls on evaluation records

prohibited_until.action: compute agreement, a DRR score or a classification
prohibited_until.until: owner freeze records for the codebook, interpretation, calibration and adjudication protocols, and real independent interpretations

prohibited_until.action: describe any result as validation or independent evaluation
prohibited_until.until: evidence created by the appropriate external authority, matched to the proposition, and counsel review of the statement
proposition-matched evidence from the responsible role, recorded in the release-gate record
